column1: # Each row is matched case-insensitively as a substring of the asset's
# `os_name`; the first matching row wins. Severity is one of
# info | warning | high. The note is surfaced as finding evidence.
# Update cadence: review this table quarterly and bump the `version` line to
# the review month (YYYY-MM) even when no entry changes. A unit test fails
# when the version is more than six months old
